newsitem.title: USA: Marsh & McLennan Q1 insurance revs edge up.
newsitem.headline: Marsh & McLennan Q1 insurance revs edge up.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc said Monday its first quarter revenue from insurance services was $562.7 million, up slightly from $555.5 million a year ago.
Revenue from its investment management business rose sharply, to $340.6 million from $238.3 million, it said.
Consulting revenue rose to $305.4 million from $276.9 million, Marsh & McLennan said.
"Our strong first quarter results support our optimism about the growth prospects for all our businesses in 1997," Chairman A.J.C. Smith said.
Marsh & McLennan said the acquisition of insurance broker Johnson & Higgins, completed March 27, will be reflected in its financial results beginning with the 1997 second quarter.
